name: Shararat - Thoda Jaadu, Thodi Nazaakat
description: The story revolves around how different people in the family adjust to the magical powers of naani and her daughters, who use their magical powers for their needs.

videos.title: Jiya's Magical Transformation
videos.overview: On her 18th birthday, Jiya receives special powers just like her mom and grandmom. Soon, the novice angel realises that wielding magic is no child's play.

videos.title: Jiya Commits a Blunder
videos.overview: Jiya seeks Nani's help to bring Pam back to her human form. Later, they set out to meet Rani Devi when things get out of hand.

videos.title: Nani Helps Jiya
videos.overview: In order to teach Pam a lesson, Nani follows Jiya to college. Later, Mita confirms Jiya's feelings for Dhruv.

videos.title: Sushma In Trouble
videos.overview: Jiya accidentally casts an odd spell on Nani, what will be the consequences?

videos.title: Jiya's Goof-up
videos.overview: In an effort to help Mita, Jiya uses a spell on Raja. Later, he proposes to Jiya in front of Mita while Nani's interference makes the matters worse.

videos.title: Nani Punishes Suraj
videos.overview: Suraj's flirting and lying make Nani punish him while Radha refuses to help him. Later, Jiya's makes the problem worse.

videos.title: Dadi Visits the Family
videos.overview: Suraj's mother, Dadi frequently fights with Nani while Jiya tries to pacify them. Later, Nani's magic spell puts Dadi in a difficult situation.

videos.title: Nani's Clever Plan
videos.overview: Nani comes up with a plan to drive Dadi out of the house by creating an evil clone of the latter, will Nani's plan be successful?

videos.title: Pams Evil Trap
videos.overview: It's holi time, but Jiya is scared of colours. Nani decides to help her with a spell while Pam makes a cunning plan.

videos.title: The Ladies Lose Their Powers
videos.overview: Dhruv fools Jiya while Suraj is delighted as the ladies lose their magical powers. Will they regain their powers?

videos.title: Pam Tricks Jiya
videos.overview: Pam engages Jiya in order to meet Dhruv. Later, Jiya seeks Nani's help to undo her blunder.

videos.title: Jiya's Truth Powder
videos.overview: Nani gives Jiya a magical powder of truth. However, a new problem arises when the plan backfires at the last minute.

videos.title: Nani to the Rescue
videos.overview: Dr. Chaddha and family arrive for dinner while Radha runs out of food. Later, a disinterested Nani agrees to help them.

videos.title: Jiya's Acting Chance
videos.overview: Pam tries to sabotage Jiya's chances of acting in an ad-film while Suraj takes an odd step. Will Nani be able to make things right for her granddaughter?

videos.title: Dhruv to Save Jiya
videos.overview: Nani commits a blunder while trying to help Jiya for her examinations. Later, Dhruv takes a stand when Pam tries to frame Jiya.

videos.title: Meet Flirty Riya
videos.overview: Radha's college friend Riya comes to visit and stirs up trouble by flirting with Suraj.

videos.title: Jiya Is in a Fix
videos.overview: Jiya's present for Suraj and Radha's anniversary turns on her. Can Jiya solve this problem?

videos.title: Nanis Ingenious Plan
videos.overview: As Jiya struggles to know about Dhruv's feelings, Nani comes up with an ingenious plan.

videos.title: Pams Evil Plan
videos.overview: Jiya and gang decide to participate in a singing show. However, the evil Pam is up to her sly tricks again.

videos.title: The Gang Supports Jiya
videos.overview: Pam's wicked plan causes Jiya to lose her voice, later the gang plans to teach Pam a lesson.

videos.title: Jiya's Triple Threatc
videos.overview: Jiya's seemingly harmful wish to be at three different places at once comes true, thus creating total chaos.

videos.title: Nani Is Punished
videos.overview: Rani Devi punishes Nani for stealing ladoos meant as an offering. Can Jiya save Nani?

videos.title: Jiya's Testing Times
videos.overview: After Nani is punished, Jiya's wish makes Pam and Mita interchange personalities. Later, Jiya seeks Rani Devi's help.

videos.title: Jiya Loses her Powers
videos.overview: Jiya's swollen finger causes mayhem when she accidentally transfers her powers. Later, Nani and Jiya go frantic to make things normal.

videos.title: Jiya's Horrible Day
videos.overview: Jiya decides to put Pam in her place by participating against her in the Miss Teen contest. Everything goes wrong when Nani's spell takes a wrong turn.

videos.title: Shanti Gets Curious
videos.overview: A curious Shanti notices Jiya's house being magically cleaned, and what follows is a hilarious investigation.

videos.title: Jiya to Reveal her Secret?
videos.overview: In spite of Nani's stern warning, Jiya wants to disclose her magical secret to Dhruv. However, things take an unexpected turn when Pam gets involved.

videos.title: Jiya's Love Letter
videos.overview: Jiya's nervousness gets the best of her when she accidentally gives Raja the love letter meant for Dhruv. Meanwhile, Pam notices something fishy.

videos.title: Dhruv Is Put to Test
videos.overview: Suraj and Nani put Dhruv to a loyalty test. Will he pass the test or stumble through the traps?

videos.title: Jiya Gets Jealous
videos.overview: Jiya gets jealous on spotting Dhruv flirting with Natasha. But who is she?

videos.title: Nani's Sudden Memory Loss
videos.overview: Nani's sudden memory loss leads to a string of hilarious antics. While the entire house is in a mess, Jiya remains unaware.

videos.title: Jiya vs Jiya
videos.overview: An evil duplicate wreaks havoc in real Jiya's life. Meanwhile, Nani punishes Suraj.

videos.title: Suraj's Jadoo Powers
videos.overview: Suraj is blessed with magical powers while Nani helps defend Jiya against Pam. Later, the entire family tries to cheer her up.

videos.title: Nani Is Jealous
videos.overview: Nani is overjoyed at Nana's return. However, Shanti's flirting with him brings her jealous side out. How will it end?

videos.title: Jiya, the Mediator
videos.overview: With the men and women of the household at war, it's up to Jiya to set things right. However, it won't be easy with Nana and Nani constantly fighting.

videos.title: Jay Learns the Secret
videos.overview: Jay spots Nani using her powers and thinks his prayers to meet an alien have been answered. Can Nani stop the secret from spreading?

videos.title: Pam Tricks Dhruv
videos.overview: Pam tricks Dhruv into going on a long drive with her. Later, Jiya and Nani's magic takes a wrong turn.

videos.title: Jiya to Celebrate Rose Day
videos.overview: With the entire college celebrating rose day, Jiya wants to spend it with Dhruv while Pam causes constant hindrance.

videos.title: Rani Devi's Human Avatar
videos.overview: In an effort to understand normal life, Rani Devi decides to spend two days as a human. However, she faces unexpected incidents.

videos.title: Rani Devi, Nani Fight
videos.overview: Rani Devi and Nani engage in war over magic. Later, Jiya comes up with a plan to patch them up.

videos.title: Jiya Acts in a Play
videos.overview: Mita urges Jiya to participate in the college play. However, the ever devious Pam vows to sabotage it with the new Drama teacher's help.

videos.title: Pam Goes Missing
videos.overview: After Piya turns Pam into an apple, the whole college considers her missing and search for her. Will Jiya change Pam or will she remain a fruit?

videos.title: Nani's Special Advice
videos.overview: Nani gives special tips to Jiya and Mita on how to get a guy. Will they succeed?

videos.title: Jiya to Impress Dhruv
videos.overview: After Jiya uses Nani's tricks to impress Dhruv, a jealous Pam gets suspicious. Later, Pam tries to sabotage Jiya's plan.

videos.title: A Surprise for Radha?
videos.overview: It's Radha's birthday, but she is irritated as no one acknowledges it. Later, Mita reveals some shocking news.

videos.title: Suraj Is Tortured
videos.overview: A jealous Radha turns Shanti into a statue while a robber enters her house. Later, the situation takes a turn for worst.

videos.title: Ghost in the house
videos.overview: Suraj gets home an antique lantern unaware of the evil presence in it. Can magic take over the ghost?

videos.title: Jiya Learns a Lesson
videos.overview: Tired of all the hate, Jiya uses her magic to make everybody get along. However, things take a turn for the worse. Can Jiya reverse it?

videos.title: Pam's Smart Wish
videos.overview: During Christmas, Pam makes a sneaky wish from Santa Claus. However, her wish causes an identity crisis at Jiya's house.

videos.title: Time for New Year Resolutions!
videos.overview: While everyone is busy making new year resolutions, a furious Jiya lands in a new mess again.

videos.title: Jiya, Nani's Time Travel Trip
videos.overview: Nani agrees to fulfill Jiya's wish of seeing her parents get married by taking her to the past but under one strict condition.

videos.title: Suraj, the Pumpkin
videos.overview: During Suraj and Radha's wedding, Nani turns Nana into a brinjal and Suraj into a pumpkin, unaware of a law that won't change them back.

videos.title: Jiya's Wrong Move
videos.overview: It's Jiya's Pari finals, Radha and Nani are rooting for her while Suraj is against it. However, a row of errors stack the odds against her.

videos.title: Jiya's Pari Finals
videos.overview: On Jiya's 19th birthday, Rani Devi decides to take her Pari finals. Will Jiya ace the finals or become a normal human?

videos.title: College President Jiya?
videos.overview: Pam dispirits Nisha to run in the college elections while Jiya vows to win it. She is left shocked when Dhruv supports Pam instead of her.

videos.title: Jiya's V-Day Celebration
videos.overview: Jiya is on cloud nine after Dhruv invites her to a valentine's day party but is scared of Suraj's rage. Later, he arrives home to find the ladies missing.

videos.title: Jiya to Teach Pam a Lesson
videos.overview: Nani tricks Shanti while Pam, Ina, and Tina decide to create trouble for Jiya. Alas, she learns about their cunning plan, can she teach them a lesson?

videos.title: Nani's Magical Typewriter
videos.overview: Nani's magical type-writer brings Jiya's words to life, literally. With her loved ones now as fictional characters, will Jiya solve this riddle?

videos.title: Suraj Gains Magical Powers
videos.overview: Suraj, Shanti and Jiya's friends become angels after eating Nani's magical cake. With everyone powerful, who will stop whom?

videos.title: Jiya's Time Travel Mishap
videos.overview: A mix-up with a spell brings past Suraj, Radha and baby Jiya to the future. Can Jiya stop the two worlds from colliding?

videos.title: Nani, Jiya's Mix Up
videos.overview: Jiya and Nani switch identities for a day, leading Nani to romance Dhruv while Jiya is an old woman. Meanwhile, Suraj suspects Nani to be in a love triangle.

videos.title: Dhruv Enters a Boxing Competition
videos.overview: Pam announces to Jiya that she is going to attend the college fest with Rohit, a 3-time boxing champion. However, she pits Dhruv against him for fun.

videos.title: Jiya's Cupid Spell
videos.overview: Jiya uses the cupid spell to help Mita and Raja fall in love. However, the magic goes wrong and Jiya falls in love with him.

videos.title: Nani Lost Her Powers?
videos.overview: Nani annoys Suraj with her magic spell. Later, Rani Devi helps him teach Nani a lesson.

videos.title: Suraj Gets a Special Power
videos.overview: Suraj is overwhelmed on getting a special power from Rani Devi. However, the power turns into a curse when he is able to read the mind of all ladies.

videos.title: Jiya's Summer Job
videos.overview: Jiya and her friends end up getting summer jobs in an advertising firm. Later, Jiya's boss gives her an ultimatum.

videos.title: Jiya Is Distressed
videos.overview: Jiya is distressed when she fails to come up with an idea for her advertisement pitch. Later, Nani plans to help her.

videos.title: Jiya's New Job
videos.overview: After being fired from an advertising company, Jiya joins a new company while Pam cosies up to a sick Dhruv. Can Jiya save her job and get Dhruv?

videos.title: Jiya Becomes Responsible
videos.overview: Jiya and her friends work at a pizza shop. Pam is least interested while Jiya shows promise. However, Pam lands in trouble with Nani.

videos.title: Trouble in Goa
videos.overview: Nani uses her magic to transport Jiya and her friends to Goa but there's a small hiccup, they don't have rooms to stay and are unable to conjure up a way.

videos.title: Pam, Shanti's Wish
videos.overview: Suraj's family spends a fun day out while Pam and Shanti wish for magical powers to teach them a lesson. Will their wish come true?

videos.title: The Gold Card Mix-up
videos.overview: The resort in which Jiya and the gang are staying, hosts a princess game. Meanwhile, two detectives add to the chaos.

videos.title: Mita in Danger?
videos.overview: Pam steals Jiya's golden card to become the princess. However, she gets kidnapped and Mita finds the card. Will Mita be safe?

videos.title: Mita's Diary Confusion
videos.overview: After reading Mita's diary, Radha assumes it to be Jiya's. The entire house is on high alert thinking Jiya wants to run away.

videos.title: Jiya's Endless Hunger
videos.overview: Unaware of Nani's magic spell, Rani Devi accidentally makes Jiya eat the first laddoo. Later, under the magic influence, Jiya eats non-stop.

videos.title: Jiya, Nani's Time Travel Trip
videos.overview: Jiya gets scared after seeing a nightmare about Dhruv getting married to Pam. To help Jiya overcome her fear, Nani takes her to the future.

videos.title: The Past, Future Collision
videos.overview: Nani gets the future Dhruv to the past. What will happen when the two Dhruv's collide?

videos.title: Nani Turns into a Kid
videos.overview: In order to help Jai, Nani transforms herself into a little girl, Pari. Can Nani prove him innocent or join him in the mayhem?

videos.title: The Magic of Fears
videos.overview: Jiya casts a spell to rid herself of her fears but ends up increasing them. The spell transfers from person to person, starting fires everywhere.

videos.title: Nani's Birthday Party
videos.overview: Jiya and her family decide to throw a birthday party for Nani. However, Shanti thinks Radha is pregnant, thus starting a chain of hilarious events.

videos.title: Jiya's Magical Mirror
videos.overview: Jiya, eager to keep her project as original as possible gets a magical mirror from Nani. However, Pam gets to it, causing trouble for all.

videos.title: Jiya, Jai's Weird Situation
videos.overview: Jiya's attempt to help her little brother from bullying turns them both as tiny as ants. With no one paying attention, Jiya and Jai struggle to stay safe.

videos.title: Jiya's Fast Forward Mode
videos.overview: A strange mix-up allows people to control Jiya using TV remote control. Her unaware family and friends find her behaviour strange and mysterious.

videos.title: Jiya Is Attacked
videos.overview: Rani Devi gifts Jiya a magical globe that teleports her to Paristan, the land of fairies. Later, Jiya takes her friends, forgetting the no human allowed policy.

videos.title: Jiya Becomes Pam's Slave
videos.overview: Sushma wagers Jiya in a bet with Shanti. However, she loses the bet and becomes Shanti and Pam's slave.

videos.title: Nani's Stern Decision
videos.overview: Suraj is over the moon about Nani's latest decision while Jiya plans a party for Dhruv. Later, Pam also throws a party, putting him in a tough spot.

videos.title: Jiya's Getting Engaged?
videos.overview: Suraj's mother sends an alliance for Jiya, much to Nani's displeasure. Later, Jiya is against the idea but is made to meet him.

videos.title: Jiya's Odd Request
videos.overview: Rani Devi makes Jiya a perfect Pari upon her request while she tries to take Nani back with her to Paristan. Later, Nani gets emotional by Jiya's words.

videos.title: Pam's Pretentious Act
videos.overview: Annoyed by Pam's attitude, Dhruv pretends to teach her a lesson while Nani and Mita instigate a misunderstanding.

videos.title: Nani's Magical Perfume
videos.overview: Dhruv and Raja bend over backwards for Pam's cousin, Jasmine. Later, Nani's usual antics makes everyone fall in love with her, literally.

videos.title: Jiya's Lie Detector
videos.overview: Nani grants Jiya a wish that allows her to detect lies. Elsewhere, Pam decides to sabotage Jiya's idea for the exhibition.

videos.title: Jiya Spreads Goodwill
videos.overview: Jiya gets into the Dussehra spirit by bringing out the good in people. Nevertheless, her plans face unexpected hurdles.

videos.title: The Gift Thief
videos.overview: A love-struck Jiya cannot stop gushing over Dhruv's gifts for her. However, every night the gifts get stolen. Can Nani find the thief?

videos.title: Jiya's Time to Shine
videos.overview: Jiya and friends decide to participate in the college singing competitions and hire a singing tutor. However, Pam plans to sabotage it.

videos.title: Rani Devi's Plan
videos.overview: Jiya, her friends, and family gear up for Diwali by making candles. Meanwhile, a disguised Rani Devi visits the house with a plan to teach Nani a lesson.

videos.title: Bebo, the Naughty Pari
videos.overview: Fed up with Bebo's mischief, Rani Devi brings her to Suraj's house. However, her pranks cause problems here as well.

videos.title: Bebo in Jiya's College
videos.overview: Bebo turns Nani into a parrot and takes her shenanigans to Jiya's college as well. Can Jiya undo her tricks before the secret is out?

videos.title: Bebo's Mischievous Act
videos.overview: In order to spend time with Jiya, Bebo uses her powers to trouble Dhruv. However, she mistakenly causes confusion between them.

videos.title: Jiya Trains Dhruv
videos.overview: Nani clears the confusion between Jiya and Dhruv. Later, she helps Dhruv train for a basketball camp selection. However, Jiya's efforts get good and bad news.

videos.title: Nani's Discipline Challenge
videos.overview: Nani takes up a challenge to discipline Bebo. However, Bebo learns about her intention and creates a disciplined duplicate. Will Nani find the difference?

videos.title: Bebo's Christmas Special Magic
videos.overview: Bebo plans to surprise Jiya and Nani with her gifts on Christmas day. Later, Jiya feels left out after Bebo uses her magic on everyone.

videos.title: Jiya to Convince Raja
videos.overview: In her attempt to make Raja go out with Mita, Jiya offers to be friends with Pam but she has plans of her own. Will Raja accept?

videos.title: Bebo's Magic Computer
videos.overview: The ever-prankish Bebo brings Rani Devi's computer from Paristan for Jiya. However, it ends up sucking in Jai, Suraj, Shanti, Raja, Mita, and Pam.

videos.title: Jai, Bebo's New Tutor
videos.overview: Suraj is furious at Jai and Bebo's academic result. Jiya helps hire a home tutor for them. Jai and Bebo unleash hell onto the tutor. Will he survive?

videos.title: The Bumper Sale Fight
videos.overview: Jiya and Nani bond by conducting a bumper sale. However, Pam and Shanti decide to conduct a sale too. With that, a sale fight ensues among them.

videos.title: Jiya's Jadoo ki Jhappi
videos.overview: Jiya wants to treat patients at Suraj's clinic with a hug while Shanti wants a hug from him. Later, Jiya is depressed when no one wants her treatment.

videos.title: Sushma's Valentine
videos.overview: Bebo makes a guy infatuated with Nani while Suraj is furious at his actions. However, bebo is unaware of Nani's surprise for Bebo.`

videos.title: Suraj or Serial Killer?
videos.overview: Jiya and the family panic when Suraj's identity matches a serial killer on the news. Does Suraj live a double life?

videos.title: Bebo Fakes an Illness
videos.overview: Bebo fakes an illness to avoid getting punished at school but can she escape Nani's watch?

videos.title: Tough Challenge for Dhruv
videos.overview: Jiya is excited about Dhruv's return from camp while he is nervous about his match. Can he win this match?

videos.title: Bebo's Magic Cap
videos.overview: Bebo's gift for Jiya turns her into a suspense killer. The magic cap travels from person to person, spreading hilarious hijinks.

videos.title: Pam the Bully
videos.overview: Pam rags all the juniors at college, against Jiya's protests. Later, Nani decides to intervene and teach Pam a lesson.

videos.title: Nani's Holi Party Plan
videos.overview: Holi celebrations are in full swing at Suraj's house. Later, Shanti and Pam scheme a devious plan.

videos.title: Nani's April Fool's Day Prank
videos.overview: It's April fool's day and Nani gears up to pull the mother of all pranks. What is her masterplan?

videos.title: Jiya seeks Cupid's Help
videos.overview: Frustrated by the constant arguing around her, Jiya summons Cupid to solve her problems but will she be helpful?

videos.title: Bebo's Paristani Fruits
videos.overview: After consuming fruits from Paristan, Jiya is not herself again. Her attitude causes mayhem all around. Will Nani be able to get her back to normal?

videos.title: Jiya to Go to Paristan
videos.overview: Jiya and Bebo accidentally put Nani to sleep. When all her attempts fail, Jiya decides to go tot Paristan.

videos.title: Jiya's Final Exam
videos.overview: Professor Bhulbhulaiya turns Jiya into a flower forcing Nani to get herself involved in Jiya's finals. Will Nani get to her in time?

videos.title: Jiya, Nani Glimpse the Future
videos.overview: A mysterious voice disturbs Dhruv and his gang. Later, a curious Nani and Jiya accidentally get a glimpse of the future.

videos.title: Jiya's Odd Problem
videos.overview: Jiya's kind heart gets the best of her when a gift she got for Bebo comes to life and torments everyone in the house. Can Jiya save everyone?

videos.title: Suraj, Nani's War
videos.overview: Suraj is against Nani and Jiya's vacation spot. Nani comes up with a fun game to decide their getaway. But Suraj won't give up that easy.

videos.title: Jiya's Summer Escape
videos.overview: Jiya's family and friends go camping for summer vacations. However, things get weird when Shanti and Pam join them.

videos.title: Ghost Camp?
videos.overview: On day two of camping, the whole gang decides to go on a jungle safari. They meet Santa Singh, who warns them of the place being haunted.

videos.title: Jiya Is Lost
videos.overview: Jiya gets jealous of spotting Dhruv and Pam spending time together. Later, an enraged Jiya gets lost in the forest.

videos.title: Jiya's Magical Blunder
videos.overview: A major power-cut strikes the city in the summer. Later, all the fairies lose their powers when Jiya tries to bring electricity back with her magic.

videos.title: Nani, the New Chemistry Teacher
videos.overview: Jiya asks Nani to help her with her boring chemistry professor. The fun doubles up when Nani decides to replace the teacher.

videos.title: Jiya Plays Supergirl
videos.overview: Jiya auditions for the role of Supergirl in an ad-film, but Pam and Shanti resolve to sabotage her dream. Can she get her act together?

videos.title: Nani Creates Dhruv's Duplicate
videos.overview: Jiya hurts Dhruv's leg while trying to teach him to play basketball. Later, Nani creates clones of Raja and Dhruv to play the match instead.

videos.title: Nani Teaches a Lesson
videos.overview: Nani cuts off the water supply to teach her wasteful family a lesson. Later, people gather outside their door as the city suffers a critical water crisis.

videos.title: Jiya Meets Dumketu
videos.overview: Much to Dhruv's frustration, Jiya befriends Dumketu, a genius in her college. Later, an Egyptian mummy returns from the dead as a result of Jiya's magical spell.

videos.title: The "Mummy" Confusion
videos.overview: The Mummy mistakes Jiya for his mother and transports her to Egypt. Later, Nani realizes the truth and rushes to save her before she is mummified.

videos.title: Bad Hair Day for Jiya
videos.overview: Jiya asks professor Bhool Bhulaiya's help to fix her hairstyle. Unfortunately, his cool bhool spray creates more trouble than she can handle.

videos.title: Jiya to Help Jay
videos.overview: A disguised Jiya helps Jay when he is called to the principal's office. Later, a string of misunderstandings leaves her feeling guilty.

videos.title: A Dracula's Scary Visit
videos.overview: A Dracula visits Jiya's house on Friday the 13th with an evil plan in mind. What happens when Nani, Bebo and Jiya team up to face him?

videos.title: Jiya in a Trap
videos.overview: Nani is shocked to see Jiya trapped inside an enchanted mirror. Later, she creates a hilarious scenario to bring her back from the magical realm.

videos.title: Nani Versus Suraj
videos.overview: Suraj wants to become the world's best cook. Alas, Nani decides to become his competition. Can Suraj live his dream of impressing Teetu Tasty?

videos.title: Jiya, Nani in Trouble?
videos.overview: A TV show host, Kobra decides to shoot at Jiya's house. He captures their magic on camera and plans to show everyone. Is it the end of all the secrets?

videos.title: The Bank Heist Part-I
videos.overview: Suraj is furious at Jiya and her friends' spending spree. Nani decides to teach them the importance of saving but ends up in the middle of a robbery.

videos.title: The Bank Heist Part-II
videos.overview: Jiya is caught in the middle of a bank robbery while Nani secretly learns Suraj's plans. With no help in sight, can Jiya solve this alone?

videos.title: Hunt for Pari's?
videos.overview: With a greedy plan in mind, a crime boss sends his goons to capture people with powers. Accidentally, Pam and Shanti end up getting kidnapped.

videos.title: Jiya's Graduation Test
videos.overview: Rani Devi puts Jiya to the test, in order to remain a Pari. With her graduation scheduled on the same day. Jiya creates a twin Jiya with a 24-hour deadline.

videos.title: Duplicate Jiya's Havoc
videos.overview: Nani and Jiya are powerless while the twin Jiya runs rampage by hurting Dhruv and her friends. Meanwhile, the real Jiya rushes to get to the prom.

videos.title: Jiya's First Job Interview
videos.overview: After the fake Jiya's foolery, Dhruv avoids the real Jiya. Suraj decides to make her financially independent. Things look up when Jiya gets an interview.

videos.title: Nani, Jiya's Time Travel
videos.overview: Nani takes Jiya on a trip down memory lane to a time before she was married after Jiya gets curious about her great grandmother.

videos.title: Nani's New Business
videos.overview: Nani secretly plans to run a new cafe while Rani Devi warns her about the strict law for Pari's. Later, Nani finds a way around Rani Devi's words.

videos.title: Jiya's First Day
videos.overview: A nervous Jiya messes up on the first day of work and tries to fix it with magic. Meanwhile, Nani takes on Raja as a part-time employee at the cafe.

videos.title: Nani's Cafe in Trouble?
videos.overview: Nani gets a solid competition from Double Magic Cafe. Later, Nani, Jiya, and Radha are shocked to learn about the owners.

videos.title: Nani Foresees a Danger
videos.overview: Shanti arranges for Pam's alliance, Pawan to meet her at Nani's cafe. Meanwhile, Nani's goodwill for Jiya turns the latter's life problematic.

videos.title: Dhruv Loses His Memory
videos.overview: Jiya and the others are distraught after Nani's strong spell creates memory loss. Meanwhile, a con man uses that to his advantage.

videos.title: Nani's New Magic Trick
videos.overview: Radha is moody after Suraj forgets to wish her on their anniversary. Elsewhere, Nani learns a new trick for Jiya and Dhruv.

videos.title: A Changed Jiya?
videos.overview: Jiya feels bad that she doesn't miss Dhruv as much as she used to while Mita takes her out. Later, Jiya ends up befriending a mysterious guy at the bar.

videos.title: Jiya's New Friend
videos.overview: Jiya goes on a coffee date with her colleague, Neel. Which upsets Dhruv, can he win her back?

videos.title: Dhruv Moves to Australia?
videos.overview: Nani and Raja's plan to get Jiya and Dhruv backfires after he decides to leave the country. However, the enigmatic Neel convinces him to stay.

videos.title: Jiya Is Enchanted
videos.overview: Nani has problems with Babli singing at her cafe. Later, Neel tries to mislead Jiya's emotions with tricks.

videos.title: Jiya's 21st Birthday
videos.overview: It's Jiya's 21st birthday, Rani Devi has a life mission for her. Meanwhile, she is heartbroken when she learns about Dhruv's plans.

videos.title: Jiya's Family Outing
videos.overview: Suraj denies Jiya's request of her friends tagging along on their family picnic day. Meanwhile, Neel reads Jiya's mind and uses it to his advantage.

videos.title: Neel's Evil Plan
videos.overview: Neel manipulates Jiya using magic. Later, he traps Suraj with a wicked goal in mind.

videos.title: Jiya's Valentine
videos.overview: On Valentine's day, Neel has an exciting surprise for Jiya while Dhruv decides to meet her. Elsewhere, Neel's duplicate escorts Mita.

videos.title: Jiya Loses Her Powers
videos.overview: A depressed Nani and Radha come up with ways to get Jiya her powers back while Neel acts innocent. Later, a confident Dhruv shows up with a plan in mind.

videos.title: Jiya to Lose her Powers?
videos.overview: Jiya and her friends want to win the story writing competition at work. Meanwhile, Neel tries to steal Jiya's powers, will the fairies learn his secret?

videos.title: Jiya Uncovers Neel's Secret
videos.overview: Jiya is shocked to learn about Neel's real identity. However, she and Nani try to reunite him with his lost brother without Rani Devi's knowledge.

videos.title: The Ladies Lose their Powers?
videos.overview: Suraj decides to find a way to make the ladies lose their magical powers. Meanwhile, Mita creates havoc on her first day at the call centre.

videos.title: Jiya's Holi Spirit
videos.overview: Jiya and Nani's new spell backfires badly. Elsewhere, as Raja and Mita try to ditch work, Nani learns a shocking truth.

videos.title: Jiya's Fantasy World
videos.overview: In order to help Jiya, Nani transports them both into a Cinderella book. However, a devious Neel tries to use magic and get the book.

videos.title: Jiya's Fairytale Ending?
videos.overview: Nani and Jiya live out Cinderella's fairytale while Neel has a way to destroy the book. Later, Bebo senses something off about Neel's behaviour.

videos.title: Neel Harms Dhruv
videos.overview: Neel lies after he is caught stealing Nani, Jiya and Radha's magical powers. Later, he tries to kill Dhruv.

videos.title: Jiya's Boss in Trouble
videos.overview: Jiya strives to help her boss when a big opportunity comes knocking their way. What happens when Jiya gets too deep in favours?

videos.title: Jiya Doubts Adi
videos.overview: Jiya suspects Adi's intentions for Mona while Shanti tries to arrange the latter's marriage. Later, Nani's blunder creates a series of misunderstandings.

videos.title: Jiya in World Magic Championships
videos.overview: Rani Devi reminds Nani and Radha about the World Magic Championships. However, accident-prone Jiya is hesitant to participate.

videos.title: Jiya and Laila Clash
videos.overview: A nervous Jiya finds out that her competitor Laila is the granddaughter of Nani's arch enemy. Later, Jiya accidentally turns all her friends in to statues.

videos.title: Nani, Radha Train Jiya
videos.overview: Nani and Radha train Jiya while Raja organises a magic show at the cafe. Later, an unaware Jiya loses all her powers.

videos.title: Jiya In Trouble
videos.overview: Devyani and Laila try their best to disqualify Jiya from the competition. Later, Nani finds a way to help Jiya.

videos.title: Jiya's Judgement Day
videos.overview: A resilient Jiya fights her way in the competition despite Devyani trying her best to thwart her chances. Will the odds be in Jiya's favour?

videos.title: The Malhotras New House
videos.overview: The Malhotras shift houses despite Nani's warnings. Later, Jiya discovers the new house is haunted.

videos.title: Ghosts in the Malhotra House
videos.overview: Immensely happy about Nani's punishment, Suraj's joy is lost when he witnesses strange occurrences. Later, Rani Devi discloses a paranormal message.

videos.title: Jiya, Radha Are Scared
videos.overview: Jiya and Radha live in fear of the ghost family while the latter has the same feelings. Later, Nani is in for a surprise when she traps a ghost.

videos.title: The Fairies are On a Mission
videos.overview: After being accidentally trapped in a bottle, Suraj has a hard time believing the fairies. However, the family gets a visit from the beyond.

videos.title: Nani Has a Plan
videos.overview: The Malhotras are tired of living in fear while Nani has a plan in place. Later, the ghost family also get prepared with their retaliation.

videos.title: Malhotras vs Ghosts
videos.overview: Nani, Jiya, and Radha find themselves in deep trouble after Yamdas helps the ghost family. Can Rani Devi help them stop the madness?

videos.title: Nani's Magic Blunder
videos.overview: In order to spend time with Jiya, Nani accidentally gets the whole office transported to the house. Later, the ghosts make things worse.

videos.title: Jiya's Smart Plan
videos.overview: Suraj is manipulated into letting a TV serial director shoot at their house while Shanti impresses him. Later, Jiya decides to put an end to the madness.

videos.title: Shanti Irritates the Malhotras
videos.overview: Fed up with Shanti's activities, Radha devices a plan. However, with the ghosts' meddling, Shanti calls the police fearing for her life.

videos.title: Shani Devi's Revenge
videos.overview: Nani gets kidnapped while a detemined Jiya tries to search her. Elsewhere, Nani's old enemy Shani Devi reveals her vengeful intentions.

videos.title: Nani in Captivity
videos.overview: Shani Devi prisons Nani while Jiya and Radha try to rescue her. Later, Rani Devi acquires the magical book to use as a bait.

videos.title: Suraj, the Ghosthunter
videos.overview: The ghosts torture Suraj and wreak havoc on the house. Frustrated, Jiya and Suraj implement their plan while Pritika gets Jiya in trouble.

videos.title: Suraj Is Under Pressure
videos.overview: Concerned about Suraj's health, his family puts him under a strict regiment. Later, Jiya's help makes the situation worse for him.

videos.title: Nani, Jiya Are Paranoid
videos.overview: Jiya and Nani are disturbed as Nidar and Preetam constantly irritate them with their powers. Later, Nani prepares a plan to get rid of them permanently.

videos.title: Jiya Liberates Ravan
videos.overview: Nani instructs Jiya to read the Ramayan while Suraj and Radha star as Ram and Sita in a play. Later, Jiya makes a huge blunder by liberating Ravan.

videos.title: The Malhotras Star in a Play
videos.overview: The Malhotras star in a play depicting Ramayan while Jiya is stuck in the book. However, she thinks of a brilliant idea, but is it too late?

videos.title: Yamraj's Plan
videos.overview: Having had enough of the ghosts, Nani and the others call upon Yamraj for help. However, things take a turn for the worse after they take his advice.

videos.title: Nani's Masterplan
videos.overview: The Malhotras take it upon themselves to fulfill the desires of the dead. However, that is easier said than done, as the family runs into obstacles.

videos.title: Dhurv Proposes to Jiya?
videos.overview: Jiya wants to meet Dhruv to mark the 4th year anniversary of their meeting. Elsewhere, Dhruv plans a surprise for her.
